items.title: Salivary parameters in individuals undergoing orthodontic treatment with clear aligners: a scoping review.
items.abstract:
AIMS: This scoping review aimed to map the salivary parameters investigated in children, adolescents, young adults, and adults undergoing orthodontic treatment with clear aligners, describe saliva collection and analytical assessment methods, and identify methodological gaps in the literature.
METHODS: The review was reported according to PRISMA-ScR and had its protocol registered in the Open Science Framework. Searches were conducted in MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and ProQuest, without restrictions on year or language. The initial search was performed on June 12, 2024, and updated on September 9, 2025. Two independent reviewers screened records in Rayyan, assessed full texts, and extracted data using a standardized form. Eligible studies were primary clinical investigations assessing salivary parameters in individuals undergoing clear aligner therapy. Data were synthesized descriptively, without a formal risk-of-bias appraisal.
RESULTS: From 3225 records, 1917 references were screened, 28 full texts were assessed, and 22 studies from 11 countries were included. The included reports comprised 880 participants across all groups (494 clear aligner and 386 comparator participants), although potential overlap between reports cannot be excluded. Most studies were prospective observational investigations, and pediatric participants were underrepresented. Invisalign™ was the most frequently investigated aligner system, although several studies used other thermoformed appliances or did not specify the brand. The included studies varied substantially in follow-up schedules, pre-sampling instructions, saliva type, collection procedures, sample processing, storage conditions, and analytical platforms. Salivary outcomes were mapped into four domains: microbiological parameters, biochemical and immunological markers, physicochemical properties, and material-related chemical eluents. Microbiological outcomes were the most frequently mapped domain, followed by inflammatory, oxidative stress, hormonal, enzymatic, physicochemical, BPA, monomer, and metabolite-related outcomes.
CONCLUSION: This scoping review provides a descriptive map of salivary parameters investigated during clear aligner therapy and the methods used for their collection and assessment. Methodological variability limits comparability across studies. Future research should prioritize standardized saliva collection, processing, storage, analytical reporting, age-stratified sampling, and transparent reporting of aligner materials and clinical context.
items.authors: de Sousa Jéssica Tavares do Nascimento, Souza Beatriz Tebalde Albuquerque de, Alves Lívia Araujo, Tedesco Tamara Kerber, Diniz Michele Baffi
items.summary_ja: クリアアライナー矯正治療中の小児・思春期・若年成人・成人における唾液パラメータの調査状況をマッピングし、唾液採取・分析方法を記述し、文献の方法的ギャップを特定することを目的としたスコーピングレビュー。PRISMA-ScR準拠で、MEDLINE/PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、ProQuestを検索し、11カ国から22研究（880名）を含む。唾液アウトカムは微生物学的パラメータ、生化学・免疫学的マーカー、物理化学的特性、材料関連化学溶出物の4領域に分類された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 研究間のfollow-upスケジュール、事前指示、唾液タイプ、採取手順、サンプル処理、保存条件、分析プラットフォームに大幅なばらつきがあり、研究間の比較可能性が制限されている。標準化された唾液採取・処理・保存・分析報告、年齢層別サンプリング、アライナー材料と臨床文脈の透明な報告が将来の研究に求められる。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性：クリアアライナー治療中の唾液パラメータ（BPA、モノマー、炎症性マーカー、酸化ストレスなど）の調査状況を体系的に整理しており、材料安全性のモニタリング観点で参考となる。ワークフロー：唾液採取・分析方法の標準化が不足していることが示されており、臨床研究プロトコル設計時の方法論的指針として活用可能。
items.study_type_ja: スコーピングレビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 唾液パラメータ（微生物学的パラメータ、生化学・免疫学的マーカー、物理化学的特性、材料関連化学溶出物）
items.sample_size_ja: 880名（クリアアライナー群494名、対照群386名）、22研究、11カ国

items.title: Why does digitally predicted tooth movement fail? the biology-digital mismatch in orthodontics: a critical narrative review.
items.abstract: Digital orthodontics has advanced through intraoral scanning, CAD/CAM, virtual planning, and clear aligners; however, discrepancies remain between predicted and actual tooth movements. This narrative review critically examined the biological and biomechanical factors underlying the limited predictability of digitally planned orthodontic treatment. A structured literature search of PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar was conducted and peer-reviewed articles were critically analyzed. Current digital systems primarily operate on geometric and algorithm-based models that assume linear and standardized tooth movements, whereas actual orthodontic tooth movements are governed by nonlinear biological processes, including periodontal ligament remodeling, bone turnover, mechanotransduction pathways, and substantial patient-specific variability. Clinical evidence shows a lower predictability for torque, extrusion, intrusion, and rotation than for tipping and expansion. The limitations of biomechanical models, force decay, and tracking loss are discussed along with AI applications in treatment planning. Future progress will require the integration of biological profiling, adaptive biomechanics, and AI-driven systems to enhance precision and manage patient expectations.
items.summary_ja: デジタル矯正治療における予測歯移動と実際歯移動の不一致（biology-digital mismatch）を批判的に検討したナラティブレビュー。PubMed、Scopus、Google Scholarで構造化文献検索を行い、デジタル計画の予測可能性を制限する生物学的・生力学的要因を分析した。現在のデジタルシステムは線形かつ標準化された歯移動を仮定する幾何学的・アルゴリズムベースのモデルで動作するが、実際の歯移動は歯槽骨のリモデリング、骨代謝、機械伝達経路、患者固有の変動性など非線形な生物学的過程に支配される。臨床証拠として、トルク、抜歯、圧入、回転はチッピングや拡大よりも予測可能性が低いことが示されている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: デジタル矯正計画の予測可能性の限界は、システムが線形・標準化された歯移動を仮定する一方、実際の歯移動が非線形な生物学的過程に支配されるという根本的なミスマッチに起因する。トルク、抜歯、圧入、回転はチッピングや拡大よりも予測困難である。
items.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 予測歯移動と実際歯移動の不一致が明確に指摘され、特にトルク・抜歯・圧入・回転で予測可能性が低いことが臨床証拠として示されている。planning quality: 現在の幾何学的・アルゴリズムベースモデルの限界（線形仮定、力減衰、トラッキング喪失）が計画品質のボトルネックとして議論されている。refinement: 将来の改善には生物学的プロファイリング、適応的生力学、AI駆動システムの統合が必要と提言されている。教育: 患者の期待管理（manage patient expectations）が将来の課題として言及されている。
items.study_type_ja: ナラティブレビュー（批判的ナラティブレビュー）
items.endpoints_ja: 各歯移動タイプ（トルク、抜歯、圧入、回転、チッピング、拡大）の予測可能性の比較

items.title: Torque expression in directly printed and thermoformed clear aligners: a controlled in vitro biomechanical comparison of power ridge effects.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Torque control of anterior teeth remains a major challenge in clear aligner therapy. Power ridges have been introduced to improve buccolingual root control; however, their biomechanical performance in directly printed aligners remains insufficiently investigated. The aim of this study was to compare the torque efficiency of power ridges in thermoformed and directly printed aligners.
METHODOLOGY: A controlled in-vitro study was conducted using a standardised maxillary model requiring incisor torque correction. Four aligner groups were evaluated: Zendura Flex thermoformed aligners (Bay Materials LLC, USA) with (ZF-PR) and without (ZF-C) power ridges, and two directly printed aligners with power ridges fabricated from TA-28 (Graphy Inc., Seoul, South Korea) and DCA (LuxCreo Inc., Bellevue, WA, USA) resin materials. Power ridges were digitally positioned on the labial gingival third of the maxillary central incisors. Biomechanical testing was performed using the Orthodontic Measurement and Simulation System (OMSS) to assess torque expression, root displacement, and force-moment systems under controlled temperatures (25 °C and 37 °C).
RESULTS: Torque expression demonstrated a clear material-dependent pattern. ZF-C, used as the baseline, showed moderate and consistent torque expression (38-39% of the programmed torque) across temperatures, with no significant temperature-dependent differences. DCA exhibited the highest torque expression, reaching 62% at 25 °C and 47% at 37 °C. ZF-PR showed intermediate performance (32-42%) with moderate temperature-related variation. TA-28 demonstrated the lowest torque expression (10-17%) with no significant temperature effect. Secondary outcomes supported these findings, with moment generation and displacement patterns correlating with torque expression, whereas force magnitude did not.
CONCLUSIONS: Torque expression in clear aligner systems is primarily governed by material properties and thermomechanical behaviour. Design features alone cannot fully compensate for limitations in material performance. Effective torque delivery depends on the generation and transmission of an appropriate force-moment system rather than on force magnitude alone.
items.authors: Khadre Aliaa A, Elkorashie Mohamed, Elzahar Mostafa Magdy, Bourauel Christoph, Fouda Ahmed Mahmoud
items.summary_ja: 熱成形型と直接印刷型のクリアアライナーにおけるパワーリッジのトルク効率を比較した管理下インビトロ生体力学的研究。上顎標準モデルを用い、切歯のトルク矯正を必要とする4群（Zendura Flex熱成形型：パワーリッジ有/無、直接印刷型：TA-28樹脂、DCA樹脂）をOMSS（Orthodontic Measurement and Simulation System）で25°Cおよび37°C条件下にて評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: クリアアライナーのトルク発現は主に材料特性と熱力学的挙動によって支配される。設計要素（パワーリッジ）のみでは材料性能の限界を完全に補償できない。
items.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: プログラムされたトルクに対する実際のトルク発現率（38-39%、62%、32-42%、10-17%）を材料別に定量化しており、治療計画時のトルク補正量の過小評価リスクを材料選択の観点から示唆する。planning quality: 材料特性がトルク発現の主要因であるという知見は、トルク矯正を伴う症例におけるアライナー材料選定と計画精度の関連に直接関連する。
items.study_type_ja: 管理下インビトロ生体力学的比較研究（Comparative Study）
items.endpoints_ja: トルク発現率（プログラムトルクに対する割合）、根尖部変位、モーメント発生、力-モーメントシステム、力的大小
items.endpoint_results_ja: ZF-C（熱成形型・パワーリッジ無）: 38-39%（温度依存性有意差なし）。DCA（直接印刷型）: 25°Cで62%、37°Cで47%。ZF-PR（熱成形型・パワーリッジ有）: 32-42%（温度関連の中等度変動）。TA-28（直接印刷型）: 10-17%（温度効果有意差なし）。モーメント発生と変位パターンはトルク発現と相関、力的大小は相関なし。

items.title: Hygroscopic behaviour and colour stability of 3D-printed and thermoformed aligner materials: an in vitro study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Directly 3D-printed aligner materials have recently emerged as an alternative to established thermoformed clear aligners. The aim of this in vitro study was to investigate the colour stability, water sorption, and water solubility of directly 3D-printed aligner materials in comparison with an established thermoformed reference, as these properties are essential for clinical performance but currently insufficiently investigated for directly 3D-printed aligners.
METHODS: Tera Harz TC-85DAC, Freeprint Aligner, Freeprint Aligner with digital polishing, Dental LT Clear V2 and one thermoformed polyethylene terephthalate glycol material (Biolon) were examined. Water sorption and solubility were determined after seven days in distilled water at 37 °C. Colour stability was assessed after 12 h of immersion at 37 °C in turmeric, coffee, black tea, orange juice and distilled water. Total colour differences (ΔE*) were calculated spectrophotometrically using the Commission Internationale de l'Éclairage L*a*b* system and converted into National Bureau of Standards units. Data were analysed by one-way ANOVA with Games-Howell post hoc test and by Kruskal-Wallis test with Dunn's test and Bonferroni correction (p < 0.05).
RESULTS: Biolon exhibited the lowest water sorption (mean 10.70 µg/mm³) and negligible solubility (median 0.00 µg/mm³). Among the printed resins, Tera Harz TC-85DAC showed the lowest water sorption (mean 17.28 µg/mm³) and solubility (median 2.50 µg/mm³), whereas Dental LT Clear V2 displayed the highest sorption (mean 29.53 µg/mm³) and Freeprint Aligner with digital polishing the highest solubility (median 17.38 µg/mm³). Turmeric caused the most pronounced discolouration, followed by coffee and black tea, while orange juice and water produced minimal changes. The thermoformed material remained most colour-stable (mean of the median ΔE* values across all immersion media = 4.21), whereas Dental LT Clear V2 showed the greatest discolouration (mean of the median ΔE* values = 27.35). Among the printed resins, Tera Harz TC-85DAC displayed the lowest staining susceptibility.
CONCLUSIONS: The tested aligner materials differed markedly in water sorption, solubility, and colour stability. The thermoformed polyethylene terephthalate glycol material consistently showed the most favourable profile. Among the printed resins, Tera Harz TC-85DAC exhibited the most favourable combination of the investigated properties, supporting its potential for clinical application.
items.authors: Kolb Jule, Wille Sebastian, Aktas Oral Cenk, Şen Sinan, Puchert Kathrin
items.summary_ja: 直接3Dプリント型アライナー材料（Tera Harz TC-85DAC、Freeprint Aligner、Freeprint Aligner with digital polishing、Dental LT Clear V2）と熱成形PETG材料（Biolon）の吸水率、水溶性、色安定性をin vitro条件下で比較した研究。37°Cで7日間の水浸漬による吸水・溶解、12時間の各種浸漬液（ターメリック、コーヒー、紅茶、オレンジジュース、蒸留水）による色変化（ΔE*）を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 熱成形PETG材料（Biolon）が吸水率・水溶性・色安定性のいずれでも最も有利なプロファイルを示した。3Dプリントレジンの中ではTera Harz TC-85DACが最も有利な組み合わせを示し、臨床応用の可能性を支持した。
items.why_matters_ja: アライナー材料の吸水率・水溶性・色安定性は臨床性能に不可欠な特性であり、材料選定が治療の臨床的アウトカム（透明性維持、材料安定性）に直接影響する。3Dプリント材料の臨床適用可能性を評価する根拠となる。
items.endpoints_ja: 吸水率（water sorption）、水溶性（water solubility）、色安定性（ΔE*）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 吸水率: Biolon 平均10.70 µg/mm³、Tera Harz TC-85DAC 平均17.28 µg/mm³、Dental LT Clear V2 平均29.53 µg/mm³。水溶性: Biolon 中央値0.00 µg/mm³、Tera Harz TC-85DAC 中央値2.50 µg/mm³、Freeprint Aligner with digital polishing 中央値17.38 µg/mm³。色安定性（全浸漬液の中央値ΔE*の平均）: Biolon 4.21、Dental LT Clear V2 27.35。

items.title: Determinants of public preference for orthodontic appliances and treatment providers: a scoping review.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Laypeople can choose from a variety of orthodontic care pathways. It is in the clinician's best interest to understand their preferences in order to tailor consumer engagement. This scoping review maps the evidence concerning laypeople's preferences for orthodontic providers and appliances.
METHODS: The review follows Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews guidelines. Two reviewers conducted a systematic search and an independent screening process across five electronic databases until December 2025.
RESULTS: A total of 56 studies (48 cross-sectional questionnaires; seven qualitative; one mixed methods) comprising 16,271 laypeople across 17 countries were included. Forty-two studies examined perspectives for orthodontic appliances, and 20 studies investigated providers. Specialist orthodontists were consistently the most preferred treatment providers, primarily associated with perceived higher quality and expertise. Direct-to-consumer (DTC) treatment appealed to a minority and was associated with lower cost, self-perceived easier-to-treat malocclusion and convenience. Adults preferred and were willing to pay more for aesthetic appliances, whereas children and adolescents perceived metallic braces as more aesthetic. Pragmatic appliance features such as effectiveness, comfort, and treatment outcomes often outweighed appearance, especially among informed or experienced patients. Common public misperceptions included confusion between general dentists and orthodontists, and overestimation of DTC safety and effectiveness.
CONCLUSION: While DTC and aligners appeal to the public demand for aesthetics and convenience, preference for orthodontists and fixed appliances remains strong, driven by perceived quality and the social acceptability of metal braces in children and adolescents. Better public and in-chair education is recommended to address misperceptions and guide better-informed decision-making.
items.authors: Jiang Lyn, Chan Alex Simon, Meade Maurice J, Freer Elissa, Mohammed Hisham
items.summary_ja: 一般市民の矯正装置および治療提供者への選好に関するエビデンスをマッピングするスコーピングレビュー。5つの電子データベースから2025年12月まで検索し、17カ国・56研究（横断的アンケート48、定性研究7、混合手法1）・16,271名の一般市民を対象に包含した。専門矯正歯科医が最も選好される治療提供者であり、DTC治療は少数派に支持された。成人は審美的装置を好む一方、小児・思春期は金属ブラケットをより審美的と認識した。実用的な装置特性（効果、快適性、治療結果）は、特に情報のある患者において外観を上回った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: DTCやアライナーは審美性・利便性への需要に応えるものの、矯正歯科医および固定装置への選好は依然として強く、感知される品質と小児・思春期における金属ブラケットの社会的受容性が駆動因子である。誤解を解消し、より情報に基づいた意思決定を導くための公衆および診療室内での教育の改善が推奨される。
items.why_matters_ja: 教育：抄録は「Better public and in-chair education is recommended to address misperceptions and guide better-informed decision-making」と明記しており、患者教育の質が治療選択に直接影響することを示す。安全性：「overestimation of DTC safety and effectiveness」が一般市民の共通の誤解として挙げられており、DTCアライナー治療の安全性に関する認識ギャップが存在することを示唆する。ワークフロー：治療経路（専門矯正歯科医 vs DTC）の選好構造が明らかになり、治療計画の入口設計や患者エンゲージメント戦略に示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: スコーピングレビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 一般市民の矯正装置への選好、治療提供者への選好、支払意思額、感知される品質・専門性、感知される安全性・有効性、審美性認識
items.sample_size_ja: 16,271名の一般市民（17カ国、56研究から包含）

items.title: Enhancing the predictability of tooth movements with clear aligners-Part 2: Clinical strategies.
items.abstract: Despite rapid advances in clear aligner therapy, the low predictability of aligner tooth movements remains a clinical challenge. This article (part 2) translates the conceptual biomechanical triad of anchorage, stress continuity, and aligner-tooth contact, along with the related determinant factors, described in part 1 into practical strategies to enhance the predictability of tooth movements with clear aligners. This paper features 3 interrelated strategic domains: patient-centered, aligner-mediated, and practitioner-directed strategies. Patient-centered strategies emphasize appropriate aligner case selection, aligner-favored treatment planning, and difficulty-based patient management. Aligner-mediated strategies focus on choosing optimal aligner materials, reducing aligner stress concentration, and optimizing aligner designs. Furthermore, practitioner-directed strategies highlight the practitioner's active role in managing the fundamental prerequisites of tooth movements (ie, force, space, and time). This is achieved through deliberate overtreatment with aligners, biomechanical augmentation with attachments and auxiliaries, judicious staging sequences that prioritize predictable movements, and dynamic monitoring and troubleshooting protocols. Collectively, in clinical practice, the 3 strategic domains should not be isolated but rather be integrated to achieve predictable tooth movements with clear aligners.
items.journal: American journal of orthodontics and dentofacial orthopedics : official publication of the American Association of Orthodontists, its constituent societies, and the American Board of Orthodontics
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、クリアアライナーによる歯移動の予測可能性を向上させるための臨床戦略をPart 1で述べられた生体力学的三要素（アンカレッジ、応力連続性、アライナー-歯接触）から実践的な戦略へ転換するPart 2である。患者中心戦略（適切な症例選択、アライナーに有利な治療計画、難易度に基づく患者管理）、アライナー媒介戦略（最適な材料選択、応力集中の低減、アライナー設計の最適化）、臨床医主導戦略（過剰治療、アタッチメント・補助装置による生体力学的増強、予測可能な移動を優先した段階的シーケンス、動的モニタリング・トラブルシューティングプロトコル）の3つの相互関連する戦略領域を提示している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 3つの戦略領域（患者中心、アライナー媒介、臨床医主導）は孤立して用いるのではなく、統合的に運用することでクリアアライナーによる予測可能な歯移動が達成される。
items.why_matters_ja: 計画品質：アライナーに有利な治療計画（aligner-favored treatment planning）と難易度に基づく患者管理が計画段階の品質向上に寄与する。planned-vs-achieved：本論文の核心は計画された歯移動と達成された歯移動の乖離（予測可能性の低さ）を臨床戦略で縮小することにある。ワークフロー：動的モニタリング・トラブルシューティングプロトコルや予測可能な移動を優先した段階的シーケンス（staging sequences）は臨床ワークフローの改善に直接関連する。教育：Part 1の概念的生体力学をPart 2で実践的戦略へ転換する構成は、臨床医への教育・知識伝達に有用。
items.study_type_ja: 叙述的レビュー（概念論文、Part 2）

items.title: Quality and reliability of clear aligner information on Brazilian orthodontists' websites: a DISCERN-based evaluation.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate, using the DISCERN questionnaire, the quality, reliability, and decision-support capacity of aligner-related information published on orthodontists' websites.
METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted in July 2024. Google (www.google.com.br) was searched using Portuguese-language keywords ("tratamento ortodôntico", "alinhadores", and "ortodontia") in incognito mode from a Brazilian IP address. The first 130 non-sponsored websites were screened; 113 met the inclusion criteria. Two calibrated orthodontists independently evaluated each website using the validated Brazilian Portuguese version of the DISCERN instrument. Inter-rater reliability was assessed using the Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC). Descriptive statistics and Spearman rank-order correlations were calculated using SPSS v.25.
RESULTS: The mean overall DISCERN score was 26.3 (SD = 5.8; range 15-52) out of a maximum of 75. The ICC was 0.87 (95% CI = 0.82-0.91), indicating good-to-excellent inter-rater reliability. Among the 113 websites, 54.3% were rated as very poor, 30.7% as poor, 11.5% as fair, 3.5% as good, and none as excellent. The lowest-scoring items were Q4 (sources of information, 99.1% very poor or poor), Q5 (publication date, 87.6%), Q8 (areas of uncertainty, 95.6%), Q11 (treatment risks, 98.2%), and Q12 (consequences of no treatment, 100%).
CONCLUSIONS: The quality of clear aligner information on Brazilian orthodontists' websites is critically poor. Orthodontists should provide evidence-based, transparent, and balanced content - including treatment risks, alternatives, and references - to support informed patient decision-making.
items.authors: Bark Mohamad Jamal, Gasparello Gil Guilherme, Machado Rosilene Andrea, Jede Tayla Granemann, Pithon Matheus Melo, Kloss Isabela Alex, Tanaka Orlando Motohiro
items.summary_ja: ブラジルの矯正歯科医のウェブサイト上に公開されているクリアアライナー関連情報の品質・信頼性・意思決定支援能力をDISCERN質問票を用いて評価した横断研究。2024年7月にGoogleでポルトガル語キーワード検索を行い、非スポンサーのウェブサイト130件中113件が包含基準を満たした。2名の校正済み矯正歯科医がブラジルポルトガル語版DISCERN尺度で独立評価し、評価者間信頼性（ICC）および記述統計・Spearman相関を算出した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ブラジル矯正歯科医のウェブサイト上のクリアアライナー情報の品質は極めて低く、54.3%が「非常に不良」、30.7%が「不良」と評価された。治療リスク（Q11: 98.2%）、治療しない場合の帰結（Q12: 100%）、不確実性の領域（Q8: 95.6%）が最も低得点であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 患者教育の観点：DISCERNは意思決定支援能力を評価する尺度であり、治療リスク・代替療法・出典の不足はインフォームド・コンセントと患者の自己決定を妨げる。安全性の観点：治療リスク（Q11）と治療しない場合の帰結（Q12）がほぼ全サイトで不良評価であり、患者へのリスク情報提供が著しく不十分であることが示された。
items.endpoints_ja: DISCERN総合得点（平均・SD・範囲）、評価者間信頼性（ICC）、ウェブサイト品質評価カテゴリ別割合（非常に不良/不良/可/良好/優秀）、低得点項目（Q4, Q5, Q8, Q11, Q12）の不良評価割合

items.title: Conversational artificial intelligence compared with orthodontic reference standards for orthodontic information: A systematic review of accuracy, readability, safety, and certainty of evidence.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Conversational artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to obtain orthodontic information, but its reliability, completeness, readability, agreement with specialist judgment, and safety remain uncertain.
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate AI chatbots for delivering orthodontic information and clinical guidance, focusing on accuracy/reliability, completeness, readability, specialist agreement, and misleading information.
METHODS: This systematic review followed PRISMA 2020 and Cochrane guidance. Embase, PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, ClinicalTrials.gov, Open Science Framework, and Google Scholar were searched. Eligible studies assessed AI-generated orthodontic responses against specialists, reference answers, or structured assessment tools. Risk of bias was evaluated using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist. Meta-analysis was not performed because of substantial heterogeneity in chatbot systems, prompts, comparators, scoring instruments, and outcome definitions. Certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE.
RESULTS: Sixteen analytical cross-sectional studies were included. Chatbots generated coherent and accessible answers to routine orthodontic questions, especially foundational concepts and patient frequently asked questions. However, performance varied by model version, prompt design, and clinical complexity. Important limitations were identified in treatment planning, individualized recommendations, contextual risk framing, and information completeness. Some studies reported incomplete or false claims regarding clear aligners, airway effects, stability, and surgery. Readability was generally favorable but did not ensure clinical adequacy. Risk of bias ranged from low to moderate, and certainty of evidence was very low.
CONCLUSIONS: AI chatbots may support routine orthodontic education under professional supervision, but current evidence does not support autonomous use. Standardized prompts, validated scoring tools, calibrated evaluators, and real-world outcome studies are needed.
items.journal: Journal of oral biology and craniofacial research
items.authors: Matos Karla Nogueira, Ferreira Giovanna Fontgalland, de Faria Almeida Marcos, de Faria Almeida Leonardo Matos, Prates Renato Araujo, Dos Santos Dantas Guimarães Hugo Henrique
items.summary_ja: 対話型AIチャットボットが正畸情報や臨床ガイダンスを提供する場合の正確性・信頼性、完全性、読みやすさ、専門医との一致、誤解を招く情報について、PRISMA 2020およびCochraneガイドラインに従い体系的に評価したレビュー。16の解析的横断研究が包含された。チャットボットは日常的な正畸質問に対して一貫性のある回答を生成したが、治療計画、個別化推奨、文脈的リスク枠組み、情報完全性において重要な限界が認められた。クリアアライナー、気道への影響、安定性、手術に関する不完全または虚偽の主張が報告された研究もあった。読みやすさは概ね良好であったが、臨床的適切性を保証するものではなかった。バイアスリスクは低〜中程度、証拠の確実性は非常に低かった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: AIチャットボットは専門家の監督下での日常的な正畸教育を支援し得るが、現在の証拠は自律的使用を支持していない。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性：クリアアライナー、気道への影響、安定性、手術に関する不完全または虚偽の主張が報告されており、患者への誤情報リスクが示唆される。ワークフロー：AIチャットボットは専門家の監督下での教育支援には有用だが、自律的使用は支持されておらず、治療計画や個別化推奨における限界が指摘されている。
items.study_type_ja: 体系的レビュー（包含研究：16の解析的横断研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 正確性・信頼性、完全性、読みやすさ、専門医との一致、誤解を招く情報

items.title: Comparison of different clear aligner systems with fixed orthodontic treatment in terms of endocrine-disrupting monomer release, treatment effectiveness and efficiency : An in vivo randomized clinical trial.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: The aim of this four-arm parallel trial was to evaluate and compare directly and indirectly produced clear aligners with fixed orthodontic treatment in terms of bisphenol A (BPA) release, as well as treatment effectiveness and efficiency.
METHODS: In all, 52 patients were randomly allocated to four treatment groups according to the appliance system used: direct three-dimensionally (3D)-printed aligners (group A), Invisalign aligners (Align Technology, Santa Clara, CA, USA; group B), ClearCorrect aligners (Round Rock, TX, USA; group C), and fixed orthodontic appliances (group D). Saliva samples were collected at baseline and at multiple time points during the first and final weeks of treatment to evaluate salivary BPA levels. Intraoral scan records were obtained at the beginning and end of treatment. High-performance liquid chromatography was used to analyze the saliva samples, and the Peer Assessment Rating (PAR) index was employed to evaluate treatment effectiveness. In addition, total treatment duration was assessed.
RESULTS: No statistically significant difference was observed between the groups regarding the BPA values measured in saliva at different time points, nor in the percentage reduction of PAR score values (p > 0.05). Total treatment duration was 6.59 ± 1.42 months in group A, 5.36 ± 1.63 months in group B, 5.72 ± 1.88 months in group C, and 10.16 ± 2.28 months in group D. The fixed orthodontic treatment group (group D) had a longer treatment duration than the other groups (p < 0.001).
CONCLUSION: No differences in BPA release were observed among the different treatment modalities. Additional long-term studies are needed to clarify the biological relevance of these findings. In terms of treatment effectiveness, no significant difference was observed between direct and indirect clear aligner techniques and fixed orthodontic treatment. The overall duration of fixed orthodontic treatment was longer than that of clear aligner therapies.

items.authors: Hashimli Nizami, Yagci Ahmet, Cadir Mehmet
items.summary_ja: 直接3Dプリント型マウスピース（Group A）、Invisalign（Group B）、ClearCorrect（Group C）、固定式矯正装置（Group D）の4群に52例を無作為割り付けし、唾液中ビスフェノールA（BPA）濃度、PARスコア減少率、総治療期間を比較した4群並行型ランダム化臨床試験。BPA濃度およびPARスコア減少率には群間差は認められなかった（p > 0.05）。総治療期間は固定式矯正装置群（10.16 ± 2.28ヶ月）がマウスピース群より有意に長かった（p < 0.001）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 直接3Dプリント型・間接型マウスピースおよび固定式矯正装置間でBPA放出量や治療効果（PARスコア減少率）に有意差は認められず、総治療期間はマウスピース群が固定式矯正装置群より有意に短かった。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：BPA放出量についてマウスピース各システムと固定式装置間で有意差がなかったことは、マウスピース材料の安全性に関する臨床的エビデンスとして位置づけられる。治療効果の観点：PARスコア減少率に群間差がなかったことは、Invisalignを含むマウスピース治療が固定式装置と同等の整列精度を達成できることを示唆する。ワークフロー効率の観点：Invisalign群の総治療期間（5.36 ± 1.63ヶ月）が固定式装置群（10.16 ± 2.28ヶ月）より有意に短かったことは、治療効率の面でマウスピース治療の優位性を示す。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化臨床試験（4群並行型）
items.endpoints_ja: 唾液中BPA濃度、PARスコア減少率、総治療期間
items.endpoint_results_ja: 唾液中BPA濃度：各時点において群間に統計的に有意な差は認められなかった（p > 0.05）。PARスコア減少率：群間に有意差は認められなかった（p > 0.05）。総治療期間：Group A 6.59 ± 1.42ヶ月、Group B 5.36 ± 1.63ヶ月、Group C 5.72 ± 1.88ヶ月、Group D 10.16 ± 2.28ヶ月。Group Dが他の群より有意に長かった（p < 0.001）。

items.title: Biomechanical analysis of maxillary incisor intrusion with clear aligners under different periodontal conditions: a finite element analysis.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To investigate the biomechanical effects and determine the optimal increment for maxillary incisor intrusion using clear aligners across three periodontal conditions via finite element analysis (FEA).
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Nine FE models were created in a 3 × 3 design simulating three periodontal states (M1: normal bone level; M2: one-third alveolar bone loss; M3: one-half alveolar bone loss) combined with three intrusion increments (0.10, 0.15, and 0.20 mm). Anterior tooth displacement, root von Mises stress, and periodontal ligament (PDL) maximum compressive stress were analyzed.
RESULTS: Tooth displacement and mechanical stresses escalated with greater bone loss and larger increments. Central incisors experienced more pronounced tipping, whereas lateral incisors achieved greater vertical intrusion. Consequently, lateral incisors endured higher stresses; their PDL stress was approximately double that of central incisors. While central incisor intrusion efficiency increased proportionally with increment, lateral incisors in M2 and M3 states demonstrated higher efficiency at the 0.15-mm increment (peaking at 92.0%) than at 0.20 mm. In the M3 state, increasing the increment from 0.10 to 0.20 mm sharply amplified lateral incisor root stress (2.96-8.18 MPa) and PDL stress (0.056-0.114 MPa).
CONCLUSION: Clear aligners produce maxillary incisor intrusion with concurrent tipping. Lateral incisors show higher intrusion efficiency but endure greater mechanical stress than central incisors. Alveolar bone loss exacerbates both tipping tendency and stress. For patients with alveolar bone loss exceeding one-third, the intrusion increment is recommended to be limited to 0.15 mm.
items.authors: Li Qiuying, Zhang Yidan, Xu Bowen, Bai Linna, Yang Kai
items.summary_ja: 上顎前歯のクリアアライナーによる圧入において、3つの歯周状態（M1: 正常骨レベル、M2: 1/3歯槽骨吸収、M3: 1/2歯槽骨吸収）と3つの圧入量（0.10、0.15、0.20 mm）の3×3デザインで9つの有限要素モデルを作成し、前歯の歯移動、歯根von Mises応力、歯槽骨膜（PDL）最大圧縮応力を解析した計算力学研究。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 歯槽骨吸収が1/3を超える患者では、圧入量を0.15 mmに制限することが推奨される。側切歯は中切歯より圧入効率が高いが、より大きな機械的応力を承受する。
items.why_matters_ja: 治療計画品質の観点：側切歯の圧入効率はM2・M3状態で0.15 mm圧入時に92.0%でピークに達し、0.20 mmでは低下するため、planned-vs-achievedの予測に直接関連。安全性の観点：M3状態で圧入量を0.10→0.20 mmに増加させると側切歯の歯根応力（2.96-8.18 MPa）とPDL応力（0.056-0.114 MPa）が急激に増大し、歯周条件に応じた圧入量のrefinementが治療安全性に寄与する。
items.study_type_ja: 有限要素解析（計算力学シミュレーション）
items.endpoints_ja: 前歯の歯移動量、歯根von Mises応力、PDL最大圧縮応力、圧入効率

items.title: Effect of power arm length and attachment configuration on maxillary molar mesialization with clear aligners: a finite element analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Maxillary molar mesialization with clear aligners is challenging because achieving controlled root movement without excessive mesial tipping remains difficult. Although power arms can modify the force system, the combined effects of power-arm length and attachment configuration on molar displacement and tipping remain insufficiently characterized. This study evaluated the effects of 6-, 8-, and 10-mm power arms combined with two attachment configurations during maxillary first molar mesialization using three-dimensional finite element analysis.
METHODS: The attachment configurations were selected to represent two clinically distinct approaches to integrating a vertical attachment with a power arm: a palatal vertical attachment combined with a buccal cut-out and a buccal vertical attachment with direct power-arm integration. Six three-dimensional finite element models were constructed by combining three power arm lengths (6, 8, and 10 mm) with two attachment configurations: a palatal vertical attachment with a buccal cut-out, and a buccal vertical attachment without a cut-out. A mesial force of 200 g was applied from a temporary anchorage device (TAD) to the power arm. Displacements were measured along the X (bucco-palatal), Y (mesio-distal), and Z (occluso-gingival) axes. Peak von Mises stress values in the periodontal ligament and aligner deformation were evaluated.
RESULTS: In all models, maxillary first molar displacement occurred predominantly in the mesial and gingival directions. Mesial crown displacement ranged from 0.068 to 0.074 mm, while distal displacement at the root apex ranged from 0.011 to 0.012 mm. Mesial tipping angles ranged from 0.155° to 0.170°, with higher tipping observed in models with shorter power arms. Increasing power arm length was consistently associated with reduced mesial tipping and lower periodontal ligament stress, but with reduced mesial crown displacement. Shorter power arms generated higher periodontal ligament stress, whereas longer power arms were associated with greater aligner deformation.
CONCLUSIONS: Power arm length and attachment configuration were associated with differences in initial tooth displacement patterns, periodontal ligament stress distribution, and aligner deformation during maxillary first molar mesialization with clear aligners. Longer power arms were associated with reduced mesial tipping and lower periodontal ligament stress, but also with reduced mesial crown displacement. The buccal vertical attachment configuration consistently produced lower mesial rotation than the palatal vertical attachment with buccal cut-out configuration at each corresponding power-arm length; this difference should be interpreted as a configuration-dependent finding within the initial biomechanical response.
items.summary_ja: 上顎第一大臼歯の近心移動において、パワーアームの長さ（6mm、8mm、10mm）とアタッチメント構成（腭側垂直アタッチメント＋頬側カットアウト、頬側垂直アタッチメント＋直接パワーアーム統合）の組み合わせが歯の移動・チッピング・歯槽靱帯応力・アライナー変形に与える影響を、3次元有限要素解析で評価した研究。200gの近心力をTADからパワーアームに施加し、X（頬舌側）、Y（近遠心）、Z（咬合歯頸側）軸方向の変位、歯槽靱帯のピークvon Mises応力、アライナー変形を測定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: パワーアームを長くするほど近心チッピングと歯槽靱帯応力は低減するが、近心冠変位は減少する。頬側垂直アタッチメント構成は、対応するパワーアーム長において腭側垂直アタッチメント＋頬側カットアウト構成よりも常に低い近心回転を示した。
items.why_matters_ja: 計画品質：パワーアーム長とアタッチメント構成の組み合わせによる初期歯移動パターンの違いが定量的に示され、治療計画時の力系設計の根拠となる。安全性：パワーアーム長と歯槽靱帯応力の関係が明確化され、過大なPDL応力を回避するための設計指針が得られる。
items.study_type_ja: 有限要素解析（計算機シミュレーション）
items.endpoints_ja: 上顎第一大臼歯のX（頬舌側）、Y（近遠心）、Z（咬合歯頸側）軸方向変位、近心チッピング角、歯槽靱帯のピークvon Mises応力、アライナー変形
items.endpoint_results_ja: 近心冠変位：0.068〜0.074 mm。根尖部の遠心変位：0.011〜0.012 mm。近心チッピング角：0.155°〜0.170°（短いパワーアームでチッピングが大きい）。歯槽靱帯応力：短いパワーアームで高値、長いパワーアームで低値（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。アライナー変形：長いパワーアームで大きい（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。

items.title: The impact of clear aligners therapy on dental caries: a systematic review.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Dental caries is one of the most prevalent chronic conditions worldwide, significantly affecting public health and individual quality of life. Orthodontic treatments, particularly fixed appliances, may increase caries risk due to plaque retention and changes in the oral microbiota. Clear aligners, such as Invisalign®, represent a removable alternative that may facilitate oral hygiene and oral health. however, their impact on caries development remains a question to be investigate to understand the real opportunity in treating patients reducing the risk of caries.
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate the effect of clear aligner therapy on dental caries risk and cariological outcomes compared with fixed or traditional removable orthodontic appliances.
METHODS: A systematic literature search was conducted up to June 2025 in PubMed/MEDLINE and Web of Science. Original clinical studies comparing clear aligners with fixed or traditional removable appliances were included according to predefined PICOS criteria. Outcomes of interest included DMFT scores, caries incidence, white spot lesions, enamel demineralization, and cariogenic bacterial profiles. Study selection and data extraction were performed independently by two reviewers, with disagreements resolved by a third reviewer. Risk of bias was assessed using ROBINS-I.
RESULTS: Three studies met the inclusion criteria (two case-control studies and one prospective cohort study). Two case-control studies reported a significantly greater increase in DMFT scores in patients treated with fixed appliances compared with clear aligners, while no significant differences in proximal caries incidence were observed. The cohort study found no significant differences in salivary levels of Streptococcus mutans and Lactobacilli between treatment modalities. Overall, no evidence of an increased caries risk associated with clear aligners was identified; however, the certainty of evidence was low.
CONCLUSION: Clear aligner therapy does not appear to be associated with a higher risk of dental caries compared with fixed or traditional removable appliances. Nevertheless, the limited number of studies and their methodological limitations highlight the need for well-designed prospective investigations with standardized caries outcomes.
items.authors: Caruso Silvia, Viarchi Arianna, Ciavarella Domenico, Tepedino Michele, Caruso Sara, Gatto Roberto, Truppa Claudia T, Mattei Antonella
items.summary_ja: 透明マウスピース矯正が齲蝕リスクに与える影響を、固定式または従来型可撤式矯正装置と比較して体系的に評価したシステマティックレビュー。PubMed/MEDLINEおよびWeb of Scienceを2025年6月まで検索し、PICOS基準に基づき3研究（2件のケースコントロール研究、1件の前向きコホート研究）が包含基準を満たした。DMFTスコア、齲蝕発生率、白斑病変、エナメル質脱灰、う蝕性細菌プロファイルが主要アウトカムとして評価された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 透明マウスピース矯正は固定式または従来型可撤式矯正装置と比較して齲蝕リスクの増加とは関連しないが、エビデンスの確実性は低く、標準化されたう蝕アウトカムを用いた前向き研究の必要性が示された。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性：透明マウスピース矯正が固定式装置と比較して齲蝕リスクを増加させないことを示唆しており、治療計画における患者の口腔健康リスク評価に参考となる。ただしエビデンス確実性は低く、臨床判断への反映には注意が必要。
items.study_type_ja: システマティックレビュー（包含研究：ケースコントロール研究2件、前向きコホート研究1件）
items.endpoints_ja: DMFTスコア、齲蝕発生率（近接面）、白斑病変、エナメル質脱灰、う蝕性細菌プロファイル（唾液Streptococcus mutans、Lactobacilli）

items.title: Clinical Outcomes of Sequential Distalization with Clear Aligners: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Sequential distalization with clear aligners is increasingly used as a non-extraction approach for correcting Class II and selected Class III malocclusions. However, evidence remains heterogeneous regarding treatment protocols, anchorage strategies, and clinical outcomes. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the clinical outcomes of sequential distalization with clear aligners, including achieved posterior tooth movement, predictability, biomechanical effects, and other clinically relevant outcomes. Methods: This systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, and the protocol was prospectively registered in the Open Science Framework. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception through 1 July 2026. Eligible clinical studies evaluating sequential distalization with clear aligners were included. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed for sufficiently comparable outcomes, and certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE. Results: Twenty-eight studies met the inclusion criteria. Pooled mean achieved distalization was 1.72 mm (95% CI, 1.02-2.42) for the maxillary first molar and 1.76 mm (95% CI, 1.12-2.40) for the maxillary second molar. Pooled distal tipping was 5.33° (95% CI, 1.37-9.30) for first molars and 5.77° (95% CI, -6.84-18.38) for second molars. First-molar intrusion was 0.58 mm (95% CI, 0.05-1.10). Movement predictability varied substantially across studies. Certainty of evidence was very low across clinically important domains. Conclusions: Sequential distalization with clear aligners may achieve moderate maxillary molar distalization but is accompanied by variable movement expression and biomechanical effects. Heterogeneous protocols and limited study quality restrict the certainty and generalizability of current estimates.
items.authors: Baxmann Martin, Zsoldos Márton, Kárpáti Krisztina
items.summary_ja: クリアラライナーによるsequential distalizationの臨床アウトカムを評価したシステマティックレビューおよびメタアナリシス。PRISMA 2020ガイドラインに従い、PubMed、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science Core Collection、Cochrane Libraryを検索し、28件の研究が包含基準を満たした。上顎第一大臼歯の平均達成遠心移動量は1.72 mm（95% CI, 1.02-2.42）、上顎第二大臼歯は1.76 mm（95% CI, 1.12-2.40）であった。第一大臼歯の遠心チッピングは5.33°（95% CI, 1.37-9.30）、第二大臼歯は5.77°（95% CI, -6.84-18.38）、第一大臼歯の圧入は0.58 mm（95% CI, 0.05-1.10）であった。移動の予測可能性は研究間で大きく異なり、臨床的に重要な領域におけるエビデンスの確実性は非常に低かった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: クリアアライナーによるsequential distalizationは上顎臼歯の中等度の遠心移動を達成し得るが、移動表現の変動性と生物力学的影響を伴う。プロトコルの異質性と研究品質の限界により、現在の推定値の確実性と一般化可能性が制限される。
items.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 移動の予測可能性（movement predictability）が研究間で大きく異なり、計画値と達成値の乖離が臨床的に重要な問題として示唆されている。planning quality: 治療プロトコルやアンカレッジ戦略の異質性がエビデンスの確実性を制限しており、治療計画の標準化が課題である。
items.study_type_ja: システマティックレビューおよびメタアナリシス
items.endpoints_ja: 上顎第一大臼歯の達成遠心移動量、上顎第二大臼歯の達成遠心移動量、第一大臼歯の遠心チッピング、第二大臼歯の遠心チッピング、第一大臼歯の圧入、移動の予測可能性、生物力学的影響
items.endpoint_results_ja: 上顎第一大臼歯の達成遠心移動量: 1.72 mm（95% CI, 1.02-2.42）。上顎第二大臼歯の達成遠心移動量: 1.76 mm（95% CI, 1.12-2.40）。第一大臼歯の遠心チッピング: 5.33°（95% CI, 1.37-9.30）。第二大臼歯の遠心チッピング: 5.77°（95% CI, -6.84-18.38）。第一大臼歯の圧入: 0.58 mm（95% CI, 0.05-1.10）。

items.title: Effects of clear aligner cleaning agents on Streptococcus mutans biofilms and thermoplastic surface integrity: an in vitro study.
items.abstract: Clear aligners are increasingly used in paediatric and adolescent orthodontics, but prolonged wear and suboptimal hygiene may promote cariogenic biofilm accumulation. This study aimed to compare the antibacterial efficacy of commonly used commercial and household clear aligner cleaning agents against Streptococcus mutans biofilms and to examine their effects on aligner surface integrity. Biofilms were grown on 48 clear aligner discs; 42 (n = 7 per group across four experimental and two control groups) were used for biofilm quantification, and 6 (n = 1 per group) for SEM analysis. After biofilm formation, discs were treated with Invisalign® Cleaning Crystals, Corega® Proguard and Retainer tablets, Invisalign® Aligner Cleaning Spray, or white vinegar diluted to a final acetic acid concentration of 0.5%. Viable bacteria were quantified as colony-forming units per millilitre (CFU/mL), and surface morphology was assessed by SEM. Data were analysed using the Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn-Holm post hoc comparisons (p < 0.05). Commercial agents significantly reduced CFU counts compared with the negative control, whereas white vinegar did not. Median CFU values were lowest for the commercial agents (1.2-2.5 × 10³ CFU/mL), with no significant difference among them, and Invisalign® Cleaning Crystals and Corega® tablets were more effective than white vinegar (p ≤ 0.04). SEM corroborated the microbiological findings, showing substantial biofilm removal without apparent surface deterioration after commercial treatment. These findings support the use of commercial products in evidence-based clear aligner hygiene protocols because of their greater antibiofilm efficacy and preservation of thermoplastic surface integrity.
items.authors: Nalbantoglu Eser Rengin, Harzivartyan Sevan, Topcuoglu Nursen, Yilmaz Hanife Nuray, Cimilli Zuhre Hale
items.summary_ja: 本in vitro研究は、市販および家庭用のマウスピース洗浄剤のStreptococcus mutansバイオフィルムに対する抗菌効果と、マウスピース表面への影響を比較した。48枚のマウスピースディスクにバイオフィルムを形成し、Invisalign® Cleaning Crystals、Corega® Proguard and Retainer tablets、Invisalign® Aligner Cleaning Spray、および酢酸0.5%希釈液で処理した。CFU/mLで生菌数を定量し、SEMで表面形態を評価した。市販洗浄剤は陰性対照群と比較してCFU数を有意に減少させたが、酢は有意な減少を示さなかった。SEMでは市販剤処理後に顕著なバイオフィルム除去が確認され、表面劣化は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 市販マウスピース洗浄剤（Invisalign® Cleaning Crystals、Corega® tablets、Invisalign® Cleaning Spray）はS. mutansバイオフィルムのCFU数を有意に減少させ（中央値1.2-2.5 × 10³ CFU/mL）、熱可塑性表面の劣化を伴わずにバイオフィルムを除去した。一方、酢（酢酸0.5%）は有意な抗菌効果を示さなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: 安全性：市販洗浄剤が熱可塑性マウスピース表面の劣化を伴わずにバイオフィルムを除去することをSEMで確認し、患者の装着安全性に寄与する。教育：エビデンスに基づくマウスピース衛生プロトコルとして市販製品の使用を支持し、患者指導の根拠となる。
items.endpoints_ja: 1) Streptococcus mutansバイオフィルムの生菌数（CFU/mL）2) SEMによるマウスピース表面形態
items.endpoint_results_ja: 市販洗浄剤のCFU中央値は1.2-2.5 × 10³ CFU/mLで、市販剤間の有意差は認められなかった。Invisalign® Cleaning CrystalsとCorega® tabletsは酢より有意に効果が高かった（p ≤ 0.04）。酢は陰性対照群と比較してCFU数の有意な減少を示さなかった。SEMでは市販剤処理後に顕著なバイオフィルム除去が確認され、表面劣化は認められなかった。

items.title: Analysis of the efficacy of AngelAligner A6 mandibular advancer and Twin Block in the treatment of class II malocclusion in growing patients: a prospective clinical study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Although the twin block is the most commonly used appliance for the treatment of Class II malocclusion, the clear aligner industry has developed systems with integrated mandibular advancement. The purpose of this study was to evaluate and compare the effects of Twin block appliances, standard AngelAligner clear aligners and AngelAligner A6 mandibular advancement clear aligners as early orthodontic interventions for patients who develop Class II division 1 malocclusion.
METHODS: The study sample comprised 60 patients with a mean age of 12.4 ± 1.3 years, who were divided into three homogeneous groups of 20 patients each and received different treatments: Twin Block (GTB), AngelAligner aligners (GAA) and AngelAligner A6 for mandibular advancement (GA6). Clinical and radiographic assessments were performed at baseline (T0), immediately prior to appliance placement, and repeated after the completion of treatment objectives (T1).
RESULTS: Class II malocclusion was corrected with all three appliances. The GA6 and GTB groups showed similar mandibular advancement, with an increase in the SNB angle of 2.1° and 2.3° respectively, and correction to Class I in 85-90% of cases, outperforming the GAA group, which showed an increase in the SNB angle of 1.2° and correction to Class I in 70% of cases. The duration of treatment was shorter in the GA6 group (15.2 months).
CONCLUSION: These findings suggest that the AngelAligner A6 MA and Twin Block are superior for skeletal correction, whereas the standard AngelAligner is effective for milder cases with aesthetic priorities.
CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT07591025. Registered 6 May 2026. Retrospectively registered.
items.authors: Scuzzo Giacomo, Scuzzo Giuseppe, Calzadilla-Suárez Elena, Alvarado-Lorenzo Mario, Criado-Pérez Laura, Curto Adrián, Alvarado-Lorenzo Alfonso
items.summary_ja: 成長期患者のClass II division 1不正咬合に対して、Twin Block、標準AngelAligner、AngelAligner A6 mandibular advancement alignerの3群（各20例、計60例、平均年齢12.4±1.3歳）で前向き比較した臨床試験。3群いずれでもClass II不正咬合は修正されたが、GA6群とGTB群はSNB角の増加が2.1°と2.3°で類似し、Class Iへの修正率は85-90%であった。一方、GAA群はSNB角の増加1.2°、Class I修正率70%で劣っていた。治療期間はGA6群が15.2ヶ月で最も短かった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: AngelAligner A6 mandibular advancement alignerはTwin Blockと同等の骨格修正効果（SNB角増加2.1° vs 2.3°、Class I修正率85-90%）を示し、標準AngelAligner（SNB角増加1.2°、Class I修正率70%）を上回った。治療期間はGA6群が15.2ヶ月で短縮された。
items.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 骨格修正の達成度（SNB角変化、Class I修正率）をアプライアンス間で比較しており、Class II症例で標準alignerのみでは計画された骨格修正が達成されない可能性（70% vs 85-90%）が示唆される。workflow: GA6群の治療期間が15.2ヶ月と短縮されており、治療計画の期間設定や患者スケジュールに直接関連する。
items.study_type_ja: 前向き臨床試験（比較研究、対照臨床試験）
items.endpoints_ja: SNB角の変化（下顎前方移動量）、Class Iへの修正率、治療期間
items.endpoint_results_ja: SNB角増加: GA6群 2.1°、GTB群 2.3°、GAA群 1.2°。Class I修正率: GA6群・GTB群 85-90%、GAA群 70%。治療期間: GA6群 15.2ヶ月。

items.title: Effects of Printing Layer Thickness and Thermocycling on the Mechanical, Morphological, Optical, and Dimensional Properties of Directly Printed Clear Aligners.
items.abstract: Directly printed clear aligners may streamline orthodontic workflows but must withstand intraoral aging. This in vitro study evaluated the effects of layer thickness (50, 100, and 150 µm) and thermocycling on mechanical, morphological, optical, and dimensional properties of Graphy Tera Harz TA-28 material. Specimens underwent standardized centrifugation and nitrogen post-curing, followed by tensile and flexural testing, Vickers microhardness, normalized light transmittance, dimensional analysis, and field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM). Thermocycling comprised 250 cycles between 5 and 55 °C. Layer thickness significantly affected strain at break, flexural force, bending strength, bending modulus, microhardness, and normalized light transmittance. The 50 µm group showed the highest strain at break and greater flexural performance than the 100 and 150 µm groups. Thermocycling reduced Young's modulus and flexural outcomes. Significant layer thickness × thermocycling interactions occurred for stress at peak, deflection at peak, microhardness, normalized light transmittance, trueness (p = 0.008), and precision (p = 0.034). FESEM showed visible layer boundaries and surface heterogeneity with thicker layers, particularly in thermocycled 150 µm specimens. Overall, 50 µm provided favorable mechanical and dimensional performance after thermocycling, but produced the greatest reduction in light transmittance. Selection requires balancing mechanical and dimensional performance against optical stability after aging.
items.authors: Rostum Isra Dilshad, Ali Omar Sabah Mohammed Jamil
items.summary_ja: 直接印刷型クリアアライナーの材料（Graphy Tera Harz TA-28）について、印刷レイヤー厚（50、100、150 µm）とサーモサイクリング（5〜55 °C、250サイクル）が機械的・形態的・光学的・寸法的特性に与える影響をin vitroで評価した研究。標準的な遠心成形と窒素ポストキュアリング後、引張・曲げ試験、ビッカース硬さ、正規化光透過率、寸法分析、FESEMを実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 50 µmのレイヤー厚はサーモサイクリング後も機械的・寸法的性能に有利であったが、光透過率の低下が最も大きかった。材料選択には、老化後の機械的・寸法的性能と光学的安定性のバランスが求められる。
items.why_matters_ja: ワークフロー：直接印刷型アライナーは矯正ワークフローの簡素化に寄与し得る。安全性：intraoral aging（サーモサイクリング）に対する耐性を評価しており、臨床使用時の耐久性に関わる。planned-vs-achieved：寸法精度（trueness, p=0.008; precision, p=0.034）にレイヤー厚×サーモサイクリングの有意な交互作用が認められ、治療計画の精度達成に直接関連する。
items.endpoints_ja: 機械的特性（引張、曲げ）、形態的特性（FESEM）、光学的特性（正規化光透過率）、寸法的特性（trueness、precision）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 50 µm群が100 µm・150 µm群より高い破断時ひずみと曲げ性能を示した。サーモサイクリングによりヤング率と曲げ成績が低下した。レイヤー厚×サーモサイクリングの交互作用がstress at peak、deflection at peak、microhardness、normalized light transmittance、trueness（p = 0.008）、precision（p = 0.034）で有意であった。50 µmはサーモサイクリング後も機械的・寸法的性能に有利であったが、光透過率の低下が最大であった。

items.title: Correction to: Orthodontic clear aligner treatment in a 12-year-old with complex Class II malocclusion: a non-extraction approach.
Effectiveness and accuracy of clear aligners in treatment of deep bite: a systematic review.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: This systematic review evaluated the effectiveness and accuracy of clear aligners (CA) for dental and skeletal deep bite correction.
METHODS: Searches in PubMed, Embase, Cochrane, and grey literature were conducted from inception to May 2024. Studies included all age groups with dental and/or skeletal deep bite treated with CA, with or without control groups, using prospective or retrospective designs. Risk of bias was assessed through Risk Of Bias In Non-randomised Studies-of Interventions ("ROBIN-I").
RESULTS: Out of 829 studies screened, 18 were included. Eight studies assessed CA's effectiveness, eight evaluated CA accuracy, and two examined both. The effectiveness in bite opening ranged from 0.4 mm to 3.8 mm, while the accuracy in deep bite correction varied between 33% and 48.88% across all studies. According to GRADE, the evidence for both CA accuracy and effectiveness in deep bite treatment was rated as low quality due to high risk of bias, indirectness, and imprecision, despite consistent findings across studies.
CONCLUSION: CA can effectively correct mild to moderate dentoalveolar deep bites; however, its efficacy in skeletal cases compared to full-fixed appliance (FFA) remains uncertain. Planned correction of deep bites with CA often falls short of the actual achieved correction, making overcorrection or refinements necessary for achieving the desired treatment outcomes. Due to the limited quality and methodological variability among the studies, recommending CA as a superior modality for deep bite correction remains premature.
CLINICAL RELEVANCE: CA may be effective for dentoalveolar deep bites but often needs adjustments for accuracy and is less effective than FFA for skeletal cases.
REGISTRATION: The review protocol was registered in PROSPERO (#CRD42022334078).
items.authors: Husain Fatemah, Riccardi Joseph, Alletto Lia, Stellrecht Elizabeth, Bejehmir Arash Poursattar, Al-Jewair Thikriat
items.summary_ja: 本レビューは、clear aligners（CA）による歯性・骨性deep bite矯正の有効性と精度を評価した。829件中18研究が採用され、bite openingは0.4 mm〜3.8 mm、deep bite correctionの精度は33%〜48.88%と報告された。CAは軽〜中等度の歯性deep biteに有効だが、骨性症例ではFFAとの優劣は不確実で、計画矯正の達成不足によりovercorrectionやrefinementが必要になりうる。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CAは軽〜中等度の歯性deep biteに有効だが、骨性症例ではFFAとの優劣は不確実で、planned correctionの達成不足によりovercorrection/refinementが必要になりうる。
items.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedとrefinementの観点で、CAによるdeep biteの計画矯正は実際の達成値が計画に届きやすく、overcorrectionやrefinementが必要とされるため、計画品質とリファインメント設計が重要。
items.endpoints_ja: 主要・副次は明示なし。CAによるdeep bite correctionの有効性（bite opening）と精度（accuracy）
items.endpoint_results_ja: bite opening: 0.4 mm to 3.8 mm; accuracy: 33% to 48.88%
